text:
Jordan: Quick check — I'm about to land a TF change that flips our ExternalSecrets annotation from `redwood.com/rotation: manual` to `redwood.com/rotation: automated` across prod clusters. Thought I'd ping infra before I merge.

Priya: @Jordan what's the rollback plan if something starts refreshing too fast?

Jordan: Good q. Plan is: 1) deploy to staging, 2) observe `secret-sync` metrics for 30m, 3) canary to two smaller namespaces, 4) full rollout with a 1h pause. Rollback is to revert the change and redeploy the controller label -> instant stop of automated rotation.

Mateo: Can you paste the exact TF diff? want to eyeball the annotation mapping and SA binding.

Jordan: Sure — snippet from the module that changes the ExternalSecret template:```
template = {
  metadata = {
    annotations = {
      "redwood.com/rotation" = "automated"
    }
  }
  data = {
    # unchanged
  }
}
```

Emily: Also check the `externalsecret-controller` RBAC — automated rotation will call the KMS unwrap, so SA needs kms.decrypt on the key ring. We recently tightened that in prod.

Priya: +1 on RBAC. Mateo, can you confirm the SA `k8s-extsecrets-syncer@infra` has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` in the prod project?

Mateo: Checking... I see the role in staging but not prod. Adding a quick TF change now to attach the role. Will push a PR to the infra repo.

ops-bot: deploy queued: infra/terraform PR #1127 — plan started by Mateo — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1127 :gear:

Jordan: Thanks. Another small request: please add the annotation `externalsecrets.redwood.com/rotation-window: "02:00-04:00"` for the first canary namespaces so rotation runs in off-peak hours.

Lisa: FYI, our Vault TTL jitter defaults are still 10m, so if we flip to automated we might see churn. Suggest setting `rotation-backoff: 5m` in the ES template for canary.

Tom: I can run the smoke tests after the staging deploy — I'll tail the controller logs and watch for `reconcile` spikes, and verify that service accounts can unwrap. Ping me when PRs are merged.

Mateo: PR updated with KMS role and SA binding. I also added an acceptance test that creates an ExternalSecret and forces a test rotation. Plan output looks clean.

ops-bot: terraform plan finished: infra/terraform PR #1127 — plan OK — changes: +1 iam_binding, +1 annotation update — details: https://ci.redwood-inference.dev/plan/1127

Jordan: Awesome. Merging to staging now. Staging first_message: `3598765440`. Will post results in this thread.

Emily: Heads-up for oncall: if you see a spike in `secret-sync.reconcile.latency` or `externalsecrets.errors` alert, rollback immediately. I'll add a temporary alert mute for the 2h canary window.

Tom: Staging deploy complete. Kicking off the test rotation (manual trigger in the test namespace). Logs look good so far — SA unwrap succeeded.

Jordan: Canary started in `canary-analytics` and `canary-payments` with `rotation-window` and `rotation-backoff` set. Observing for 35m.

Mateo: Not seeing any unexpected churn. One small log noise: controller emits `warning: stale cache miss` during reconcile, but no failures.

ops-bot: audit: ExternalSecret rotation event — ns=canary-payments secret=my-payments-key status=rotated by=k8s-extsecrets-syncer

Jordan: Looks good to me. I'll schedule the full rollout for tomorrow at 03:00 UTC with a 1h pause halfway. Thanks everyone for quick reviews. :thumbsup:

Emily: I'll attach the checklist to the rollout ticket and add the mute/alert windows.

Tom: Approved — will watch the rollout.

Lisa: One follow-up for next week: add an integration test that simulates KMS latency to ensure rotation backoff behaves.

Jordan: Noted. Filing a follow-up issue. Thanks all.
